payload.name: Retrieve multi-topic merged memories for enumerative coping questions
payload.description: When a question asks what helped a person cope, grieve, or find peace, decompose it into per-facet searches and include keyword/BM25 to catch long multi-topic merged memories that one semantic top-k may miss.
content: When a question asks what helped someone cope, grieve, or find peace, do not rely on a single broad semantic top-k search; decompose the question into distinct facets (practices, places, objects) and run a separate search for each facet.

Long merged memories that combine several topics dilute semantic relevance and can fall below the cutoff; when a facet lacks evidence, run a keyword or BM25 search with that facet's distinctive terms and inspect merged multi-topic versions.
Before finalizing an enumerative answer, ensure every plausible facet has supporting evidence or an explicit search attempt; treat the first semantic result set as non-exhaustive.

solves: A single semantic search missed a multi-topic merged memory linking yoga to grief-comfort because merged memories dilute per-topic relevance. For enumerative questions asking what helped a person cope, grieve, or find peace, decompose into per-facet searches and add keyword/BM25 to surface merged memories; not needed when the question targets one narrow, already-evidenced facet.
